topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: Some examples of transaction costs include: Commissions ... Markups/Markdowns ... Loads
question: Misconception: If a broker does not charge a commission, buying or selling securities has no transaction costs.
answer: Not necessarily. Commissions are only one type of transaction cost. A broker-dealer may also receive a markup or markdown when trading from its own inventory, and some mutual fund or variable annuity shares have sales loads. Check which fees may apply to your account and investments.
